entities.name: Dissension
entities.description: The third book and conclusion of the Ravnica cycle, written by Cory Herndon and published in May 2006.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The guild-ruled plane and city, sealed off from the rest of the multiverse, where guild fights guild and monsters ravage the streets.

entities.name: Agrus Kos
entities.description: A dead Wojek turned spectral guard whom the Azorius bring back inside borrowed bodies; his arrest of Szadek broke the Guildpact.

entities.name: Feather
entities.description: An angel who spent a decade in Agyrem, is charged before the Azorius Senate, and later becomes the new Boros guildmaster.

entities.name: Evern Capobar
entities.description: A master thief who retrieves the dragons' cerebral fluid for a Guildmaster and later warns Kos about Momir Vig.

entities.name: Crixizix
entities.description: An Izzet League leader in Utvara, newly named for her higher rank, who loses faith in Niv-Mizzet.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: The Izzet guildmaster and parun, a dragon who defeats two Nephilim then retreats claiming boredom.

entities.name: Nephilim
entities.description: Five gigantic creatures, raised from the dragons Zomaj Hauc made, that cause chaos and destruction.

entities.name: Fonn
entities.description: A part-time Wojek and part-time Ledev, ex-wife of Jarad and mother of Myc.

entities.name: Jarad
entities.description: The Devkarin Guildmaster of the Golgari, Myc's father; he is killed by Lyzolda and returns as a zombie.

entities.name: Myc Zunich
entities.description: Jarad and Fonn's son, taken by Rakdos cultists and given a mind link with the demon god; he decides to become a Golgari hunter.

entities.name: Teysa
entities.description: A baroness who is asked to be Feather's Advokist at Prahv.

entities.name: Dr. Otrovac
entities.description: A Simic scientist who tries to sell cytoplast enhancements to Jarad.

entities.name: Wenslauv
entities.description: A Skyjek air marshal who witnesses the reappearance of the Parhelion.

entities.name: Parhelion
entities.description: The flying ship of Razia and the angels, which reappears over Ravnica and crashes into Prahv.

entities.name: Razia
entities.description: The angelic Boros Parun and Guildmaster, killed by the ghost of Szadek.

entities.name: Lyzolda
entities.description: The acting Guildmaster of the Rakdos who raises the demon Rakdos using blood and the dragons' cerebral fluid.

entities.name: Rakdos
entities.description: The demon parun of the Rakdos cult whom Lyzolda raises.

entities.name: Momir Vig
entities.description: A Simic guildmaster who contracts Evern and builds the Experiment Kraj in order to rule Ravnica.

entities.name: Szadek
entities.description: A ghost and Augustin's captive eternal enemy whose capture by Kos broke the Guildpact.

entities.name: Savra
entities.description: A Golgari matka whose body Svogthir inhabits and whose corpse Kos later takes over.

entities.name: Svogthir
entities.description: The God-Zombie who inhabits Savra's body and works with Momir Vig.

entities.name: Augustin IV
entities.description: The Azorius grand arbiter who secretly controls Szadek and seeks martial law over Ravnica.

entities.name: Obez Murzeddi
entities.description: An Azorius ectomancer whose body Kos's spirit is placed in.

entities.name: Pivlic
entities.description: A tavern owner in Utvara who is saved by Crixizix and warns Teysa.

entities.name: Experiment Kraj
entities.description: A Simic creation needing the dragon's cerebral fluid, which absorbs Rakdos.

entities.name: Agyrem
entities.description: A mysterious place created where Ravnica's seal folded over itself, home to the ghosts of Ravnica; it later overlays Ravnica as a new quarter.

entities.name: The Schism
entities.description: A rift created by Zomaj Hauc that snagged Agyrem and trapped the Parhelion.

entities.name: Guildpact
entities.description: The magical pact binding Ravnica's guilds, which Kos is said to have broken.

entities.name: Prahv
entities.description: The Azorius guildhall where the Senate meets and Feather is tried.

entities.name: Utvara
entities.description: A district where the Nephilim cause destruction and Crixizix works.

entities.name: Rix Maadi
entities.description: The Rakdos dungeon palace where Myc is taken.

entities.name: Novijen
entities.description: The Simic headquarters where Momir Vig activates Kraj.

entities.name: Izzet League
entities.description: The Ravnican guild of Niv-Mizzet and Crixizix.

entities.name: Golgari Swarm
entities.description: The Ravnican guild led by Jarad.

entities.name: Zomaj Hauc
entities.description: The creator of the Schism who raised the dragons in the Guildpact novel.

events.summary: Evern Capobar and his shadewalkers sneak into the remains of the Cauldron past feasting Nephilim and take dragon cerebral fluid.
events.quote: Using a syringe, they confiscate some of the dragons' cerebral fluid and leave.

events.summary: Crixizix watches the five Nephilim grow gigantic and calls on Niv-Mizzet through the Firemind.
events.quote: She uses the Firemind to contact Niv-Mizzet .

events.summary: Feather is brought before the Azorius and Teysa recognizes her as the client who wants her as Advokist.
events.quote: When she reaches the cell, she recognizes her client as the angel known as Feather .

events.summary: Niv-Mizzet defeats two Nephilim, then retreats; Crixizix abandons hope in her guildmaster.
events.quote: Niv-Mizzet arrives in Utvara and defeats two of the Nephilim (Witch-Maw and Dune-Brood), before taking minor damage.

events.summary: Rakdos cultists attack Fonn and her scouts, knocking Fonn out and taking Myc and the others.
events.quote: Fonn and her scouts (her son being among them) are attacked by a group of Rakdos cultists.

events.summary: Jarad declines Dr. Otrovac's offer of cytoplast enhancements, suspecting a trick.
events.quote: Jarad fails to see the benefit for the Simic, and declines the offer, thinking something fishy is behind it.

events.summary: The Parhelion reappears over Ravnica and Wenslauv warns Prahv it is on a collision course.
events.quote: Skyjek Air Marshal Wenslauv witnesses a terrifying event- the reappearance of Parhelion , the flying ship of Razia and the angels, on Ravnica.

events.summary: Evern's partners sold dragon fluid to Lyzolda; they meet contractor Momir Vig and partners Szadek and Savra.
events.quote: they sold some of the dragon's liquid to Lyzolda , the acting Guildmaster of the Rakdos.

events.summary: Feather explains that Ravnica's seal folded over itself to create Agyrem, where the ghosts live.
events.quote: Like a blister on the skin, the seal folded over itself to create Agyrem , a mysterious place where the ghosts of Ravnica live.

events.summary: Flashback: in Agyrem, the ghost of Szadek kills Razia and Feather flees.
events.quote: Then the ghost of Szadek appears and kills Razia.

events.summary: The Azorius place Kos's spirit in the body of ectomancer Obez Murzeddi.
events.quote: The Azorius put the spirit of Agrus Kos inside the body of an Azorius ectomancer named Obez Murzeddi .

events.summary: Augustin tells Kos he broke the Guildpact by arresting Szadek.
events.quote: Kos broke the Guildpact.

events.summary: Evern warns Kos and Augustin that Momir Vig and the Simic work with the God-Zombie Svogthir in Savra's body.
events.quote: Evern Capobar shows up to warn them about Momir Vig and the Simic, who are working together with the God-Zombie Svogthir who was inhabiting the body of Savra.

events.summary: The Parhelion crashes into Prahv.
events.quote: but it is too late and Parhelion crashes into Prahv.

events.summary: Lyzolda uses Myc's blood to raise Rakdos but Jarad's intervention disrupts the ritual and links Myc's mind to the demon.
events.quote: The demon is awakened but the intervention of Jarad disrupts the ritual and gives Myc a mind link with the demon god instead.

events.summary: Myc and Rakdos rampage into the main city and attack Vitu-Ghazi.
events.quote: They both head into the main city, destroying everything in their path, killing a Nephilim, and beginning an attack against Vitu-Ghazi .

events.summary: Momir Vig explains that the dragon's fluid was needed to complete Experiment Kraj.
events.quote: explains how the dragon's cerebral fluid was needed to complete the Experiment Kraj .

events.summary: Lyzolda kills Jarad and uses his blood to complete the ritual and take control of Rakdos.
events.quote: Jarad catches up with Lyzolda, who kills him and uses his blood to complete the ritual and take control of Rakdos.

events.summary: Kos transfers into Savra's corpse, overpowering Svogthir, and kills Momir Vig before he can control Kraj.
events.quote: but then Kos kills Vig before he can take control of Kraj completely.

events.summary: Kraj absorbs Rakdos and goes still; Lyzolda collapses from the backlash and is eaten alive by her cultists.
events.quote: Lyzolda suffers the backlash from Rakdos' wounds, collapses, and is eaten alive by the other cultists.

events.summary: Augustin reveals he took control of the captured Szadek and wants a new Ravnica where everyone follows the law.
events.quote: Augstin wants to create a new Ravnica, where everyone follows the law.

events.summary: Szadek, released from Kos's grounder, sucks Augustin's soul out, then the Parhelion explodes.
events.quote: When Szadek erupts from his prison, he immediately recognizes Augustin and sucks his soul right out of his body.

events.summary: Fonn brings Myc to Jarad, now a zombie; Myc decides to become a Golgari hunter.
events.quote: Fonn brings her son to his father, who used necromancy to become a zombie.

events.summary: Two years later Kos is brought back to Ravnica as a ghost with a semi-corporeal body.
events.quote: Two years later the new Azorius guildmaster, on behalf of Feather (who has become the new Boros guildmaster), manages to bring Kos back to Ravnica.

events.summary: A new Guildpact is created, the Schism fades and Agyrem overlays Ravnica; Kos becomes Boros commander there.
events.quote: Kos accepts the task of becoming the Boros commander for that area.

relations.note: Jarad is the Devkarin Guildmaster of the Golgari.
relations.quote: Jarad , the Devkarin Guildmaster of the Golgari , is teaching his son Myc Zunich how to hunt.
Jarad , the Devkarin Guildmaster of the Golgari , is teaching his son Myc Zunich how to hunt.
Fonn, who is revealed to be his ex-wife, shows up to bring Myc along on a training mission for Ledev scouts.

relations.note: Her higher ranking within the Izzet League earned her the new name.
relations.quote: Crix (who is now named Crixizix due to her higher ranking within the Izzet League )

relations.note: Lyzolda is acting Guildmaster of the Rakdos.
relations.quote: they sold some of the dragon's liquid to Lyzolda , the acting Guildmaster of the Rakdos.

relations.note: Szadek and Savra are Vig's partners.
relations.quote: They meet up with their contractor, Momir Vig , and his two mysterious partners, Szadek and Savra .

relations.note: The ghost of Szadek kills Razia.
relations.quote: Then the ghost of Szadek appears and kills Razia.

relations.note: Kos is the only one able to destroy Szadek.
relations.quote: Therefore, Kos is the only person capable of destroying Szadek while Augustin worries about the Guildpact.

relations.note: She kills him to use his blood in the ritual.
relations.quote: Jarad catches up with Lyzolda, who kills him and uses his blood to complete the ritual and take control of Rakdos.

relations.note: Kos kills Vig before he can control Kraj.
relations.quote: but then Kos kills Vig before he can take control of Kraj completely.

relations.note: Augustin finished off Szadek in the dungeons and took control of him.
relations.quote: Kos did break the Guildpact, but when Szadek was captured, Augustin finished his eternal enemy off easily in the dungeons and took control of him.

relations.note: Szadek sucks Augustin's soul from his body.
relations.quote: When Szadek erupts from his prison, he immediately recognizes Augustin and sucks his soul right out of his body.
